pyqgis_plugin.name: Fillet & Chamfer for QGIS 3.x (Interactive & Batch)
pyqgis_plugin.description: Interactive Fillet, Chamfer, Corner Restoration & CAD Rotation tools for QGIS with instant Batch Fillet/Chamfer for selected features.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Comprehensive CAD editing suite providing interactive Fillet (corner rounding), Chamfer (corner beveling), Two-Edge Corner Restoration (Unfillet / Unchamfer), and 3-Point CAD Rotation map tools for QGIS, along with an instant batch fillet and chamfer dock panel for selected vector features across QGIS 3.x and QGIS 4.x.
pyqgis_plugin.tags: cad, editing, fillet, chamfer, unfillet, corner, restore, rotate, rotation, geometry, digitizing, curve, batch, qgis4
pyqgis_plugin.change_log: 1.0.0.14: - Enabled CAD Rotate tool and toolbar button strictly when editable layer has selected features (with dynamic selectionChanged tracking). - Positioned CAD Rotate action on Advanced Digitizing Toolbar directly after standard Rotate Feature action. - Implemented clean step-back and instant visual cleanup on Escape / Right-Click interruption. - Added interactive CAD 3-Point Rotation Map Tool (Pivot -> Reference Baseline -> Angle) with full native QGIS snapping support, on-canvas CAD HUD widget, angle locking, step snapping, and copy mode. - Restricted numeric stepper inputs to digits only and normalized decimal separator (dot/comma) handling across canvas HUD and batch panel. - Added interactive CAD Two-Edge Corner Restoration tool (Unfillet / Unchamfer) with real-time intersection preview. - Dedicated toolbar button with custom QGIS delete-badge icon for corner reconstruction. - Added Batch Processing dock panel for instant Fillet and Chamfer on selected features in QGIS 3.x and QGIS 4.x. - Fixed all Qt6 / PyQt6 / QGIS 4.0 scoped enum compatibility issues. - Full CRS adaptation (metric meters and geographic degrees EPSG:4326). - Localized in 40 languages (all official QGIS GUI locales). 1.0.0.0: - Initial release of Fillet & Chamfer Tool for QGIS.
